accepted.feature: Guild Temple and Mithraeum of Fructosus
accepted.quote: The guild temple dates to the reign of Alexander Severus (222 - 235 CE). Based on epigraphic evidence, this shrine may belong to the guild of the stuppatores. A mithraic shrine with a patron named Fructosus is to be found in the substructure of the podium. Representative point: longitude 12.287804, latitude 41.753187.
accepted.note: The source dates the guild temple to the reign of Alexander Severus (222-235 CE), so the start is approximate; the mithraeum lies in the substructure of the podium.
